why_this_arm_only: the quality arm cannot be sized or analysed until human-anchored calibration labels exist, so only the completion arm is pre-registered now
episodes_existing_at_freeze_note: any block used to test this preregistration must consist of episodes beyond these, identified by episode id

hypothesis.statement: the share of episodes completing within the declared ceilings differs between the minimal condition and the scaffold-plus-retrieval condition
hypothesis.direction: not specified; the observed direction in the pilot block is not used to set a one-sided test
hypothesis.null: the two conditions complete within budget at the same rate

primary_comparison.outcome: admissible under every declared ceiling, as decided by the committed admission path

analysis.test: two-sided Fisher exact test on the two-by-two table of condition against completion
analysis.why_fisher: completion counts are small and one arm may sit at or near a boundary, where a normal approximation is unreliable
analysis.effect_reported: difference in completion rate with a Wilson interval on each arm, reported with denominators
analysis.secondary: the same comparison for the two single-factor conditions, reported without an alpha claim and labelled exploratory

exclusions.rule: no episode is excluded for its outcome. An episode is excluded only if its transcript is incomplete, so its usage cannot be measured at all
exclusions.ceiling_violation_is_not_an_exclusion: a ceiling violation is the outcome under test and must never remove an episode from the denominator

stopping_rule.rule: the block runs to its pre-registered size and is analysed once
stopping_rule.why: stopping when a difference appears inflates the error rate, and the whole point of fixing the size in advance is to remove that option

falsifier: if the Fisher test does not reject at the pre-registered alpha, the completion difference seen in the pilot block is not supported and must be reported as unsupported rather than described as a trend
what_this_cannot_show: nothing about design quality, which is a separate outcome blocked on human labels
nothing about why a condition uses more calls; the comparison is on completion, not on mechanism
no causal claim beyond the two tasks in the block
authority: this preregistration is fixed before any episode beyond those listed above exists; a later block that reuses those episodes does not test it
sealing_note: sealed_sha256 is null while the block has not grown beyond the frozen count. It must be set to this file own digest before any further episode is added, after which the gate refuses any change.
